question: Who was honoured with the Padma Bhushan in 2025 for their contributions to Indian cinema?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shekhar Kapur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shekhar Kapur** was honored with the **Padma Bhushan** in the year **2025** for his outstanding contributions to **Indian cinema**.
 
• The **Padma Bhushan** is the third-highest civilian award in India, which recognizes distinguished service of a high order to the nation in any field.
 
• Shekhar Kapur is an internationally acclaimed filmmaker, known for his work in critically acclaimed movies such as **"Bandit Queen," "Elizabeth,"** and **"Elizabeth: The Golden Age."**
 
• He is celebrated for his cinematic storytelling, which often explores complex characters and deep historical narratives, earning him several accolades globally.
 
• The award was conferred upon him for his immense contribution to the Indian film industry, as well as his efforts to bring Indian cinema to the global stage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shekhar Kapur:**

 
 
• Born on **6 December 1945**, Shekhar Kapur is an Indian filmmaker and actor known for his work in both Bollywood and Hollywood.
 
• His film **"Bandit Queen" (1994)** won the **National Film Award for Best Feature Film** in Hindi and gained international acclaim for its depiction of the life of Phoolan Devi.
 
• He directed the Oscar-winning historical drama **"Elizabeth" (1998)** and its sequel **"Elizabeth: The Golden Age" (2007).**
 
• Shekhar Kapur has also been a **UNICEF ambassador** and has contributed to several global humanitarian causes.
 
 
 
• **Padma Bhushan Award:**
 
 
• The Padma Bhushan is one of the **highest civilian awards** in India, instituted in **1954**.
 
• It is awarded to individuals for their exceptional service in various fields like **arts, literature, science, public affairs, sports, and social work**, among others.
 
• The awardees are announced annually on **Republic Day**, and the awards are presented by the **President of India**.
 
 
 
• **Other Notable Contributions of Shekhar Kapur:**
 
 
• He served as the jury president of the **Cannes Film Festival** in 2010, showcasing his influence in global cinema.
 
• In addition to filmmaking, Kapur has been involved in several environmental and social initiatives, advocating for **sustainable development and water conservation**.
 
• He is also known for his work in documentaries, including a project on the **Dalai Lama**.
 
 
 
• **Padma Awards:**
 
 
• The Padma Awards are conferred in three categories: **Padma Vibhushan** (for exceptional and distinguished service), **Padma Bhushan** (distinguished service of higher order), and **Padma Shri** (distinguished service).
 
• These awards are aimed at recognizing individuals who have contributed significantly to their respective fields and have brought pride to the nation.
 
• Some other notable recipients of the Padma Bhushan include **Ratan Tata, Sachin Tendulkar, and Asha Bhosle**.
